query: select a.id as application, count(distinct cve.id) as cves, max(min(10, round(cve.impactScore + cve.exploitabilityScore, 1))) as maxScore from Application a join Software s on s.id = a.software join vulnerability v on v.vendor = s.vendor and v.software = s.name join cve on cve.id = v.cve where s.id <> 'linux_kernel' group by a.id order by 3 desc, 2 desc
